name: .224 Cal-76gr Absolute Hammer™

slowestTwist.raw: Minimum required twist rate is 1-7″ or faster

note: Recommended use: Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "This 76gr Absolute Hammer™ will produce extreme velocity in your custom fast twist 22 caliber rifle. Absolute Hammer™s do not line up with conventional load data, so they should only be used by experienced reloaders. Because of the very low engraving pressure they will not line up with conventional load data."
